text:
By Data Skrive ,
6 hours ago
The Chicago White Sox (45-40), led by Miguel Vargas, visit Brayan Rocchio and the Cleveland Guardians (45-42) at 6:40 p.m. ET on Thursday.
Keep reading to find out how to watch the Chicago-Cleveland matchup in the article below.
When is White Sox vs. Guardians and when does it start? This matchup between the White Sox and Guardians will take place on Thursday, July 2, 2026. You should expect the opening pitch at 6:40 p.m. ET.
Where to watch White Sox vs. Guardians The White Sox and Guardians will take to the diamond at Progressive Field for this matchup on July 2, and if you’d like to see the game live, get your tickets now from Vivid Seats !
What channel is the game on? You can catch this game live on CleGuardians.TV and CHSN.
Watch the White Sox vs. Guardians live stream on Fubo Live Stream Online: Sign up for Fubo today!
White Sox vs. Guardians Game Preview White Sox Stats, Odds & Insights The White Sox have won 64.3% of the games this season when they were the moneyline favorite (9-5).
Chicago is second in baseball with 119 home runs. They average 1.4 per game.
The White Sox rank seventh in MLB with a .416 slugging percentage.
Chicago has the 17th-ranked team ERA across all MLB pitching staffs (4.24).
The White Sox have the 18th-ranked WHIP in baseball (1.329).
Guardians Stats, Odds & Insights The Guardians have been underdogs in 40 games this season and won 21 (52.5%) of those contests.
Cleveland has hit 79 homers this season, which ranks 25th in the majors.
The Guardians rank last in the majors with a .366 team slugging percentage.
Cleveland has pitched to a 3.77 ERA this season, which ranks eighth in baseball.
Guardians pitchers have a 1.261 WHIP this season, 11th in the majors.

He is 9-3 with a 3.00 ERA and 90 strikeouts in 93 2/3 innings pitched.
In his most recent appearance on Saturday against the Kansas City Royals, the right-hander threw 5 1/3 scoreless innings while surrendering four hits.
The 29-year-old has amassed an ERA of 3.00, with 8.7 strikeouts per nine innings, in 16 games this season. Opponents have a .247 batting average against him.
Vargas leads Chicago in runs batted in with 52 while batting .244.
Sam Antonacci’s batting average of .295 leads all Chicago hitters this season.
Colson Montgomery is slugging .482 this season, with a team-high 21 home runs. He’s also collected 49 RBI.

The right-hander allowed three hits in six scoreless innings pitched against the Seattle Mariners on Saturday.
The 27-year-old has pitched in 17 games this season with an ERA of 4.18, a 2.41 strikeout-to-walk ratio and a WHIP of 1.362.
Rocchio has 13 doubles, two triples, five home runs and 25 walks while batting .270.
Chase DeLauter’s 38 RBI and .275 batting average both pace his team.
